Class AbstractAgentExecutor

java.lang.Object
tech.kayys.wayang.agent.executor.AbstractAgentExecutor
All Implemented Interfaces:
tech.kayys.gamelan.sdk.executor.core.WorkflowExecutor
Direct Known Subclasses:
OrchestratorSkillExecutor, SkillBasedAgentExecutor
public abstract class AbstractAgentExecutor extends Object implements tech.kayys.gamelan.sdk.executor.core.WorkflowExecutor
Abstract base class for all agent executors Implements the WorkflowExecutor interface from gamelan-sdk-executor-core
